# community-browser

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The tweakcn community catalog as a browsable theme source (picking a theme saves it as a saved theme). Its import-by-URL customizer section is the `customizer` child. Serves the tweakcn community catalog (the live tweakcn.community-catalog value), and the endpoint that saves one of its themes as a saved theme.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `ThemeEngine.ThemeSource` "community"
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.useFetchEndpoint`
    - `network/live.useLive`
    - `network/live/live-state.combineResources`
    - `network/live/live-state.mapResource`
    - `network/live/live-state.PortableGateInput`
    - `network/live/live-state.ResourceResult`
    - `ui/theme-engine.ThemeEngine`
    - `ui/theme-engine.ThemeSourceEntry`
    - `ui/theme-engine.useThemes`
    - `ui/theme-engine/saved-themes.useAwaitSavedThemesWrite`
- Server:
  - Contributes: `resource.declare` "tweakcn.community-catalog"
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.HttpError`
    - `infra/endpoints.implement`
    - `network/live.serveValue`
    - `ui/theme-engine/saved-themes.saveTheme`
  - Resources: `tweakcn.community-catalog` (push, fixed, whole: a snapshot bundled with the code (522 themes today), never grown by user data — and the gallery searches and filters every entry, whole: one theme's tags — a handful, whole: one tweakcn theme's CSS variables — tens of tokens)
  - Routes: `POST /api/tweakcn/community/apply`
- Core:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/endpoints.defineEndpoint`
    - `ui/theme-engine/saved-themes.SavedThemeWriteSchema`
  - Exports (values): `applyCatalogTheme`
- Shared:
  - Exports (types): `CatalogTheme`
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`customizer`** — The Import from tweakcn customizer section: imports any tweakcn theme by URL.
